exposure: postnatal coverage of the intestine with a silastic bag
first intervention within the first 6 hours after birth
attempt of primary abdominal wall closure
outcome: perinatal management of babies born with gastroschisis
cohort: Newborns with gastroschisis in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland
finding: While a standard procedure was identified for some aspects of gastroschisis management, there was a lack of standardization for many crucial parameters, highlighting the need for prospective randomized-controlled multicenter studies.
mod_finding: Planned delivery through cesarean section was a standard procedure.
